You're probably thinking you'd never get an email like this -- you might even be bracing for it to be bad news. Let me put you at ease right now: it's not.

List with an agent~$7,500 list price, minus 6% commission, minus repairs to make it listable, minus ~90-day carry costs -- realistic net around $-11,062. And only IF it sells.
